input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT a.month, SUM(a.card_spend_eur)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) spend_per_active, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) txns_per_active, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active) active_users FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' GROUP BY a.month) SELECT month, spend_per_active, txns_per_active, active_users FROM m WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month <= DATE '2025-05-01' ORDER BY month
